out_of_scope: M15 CROSSFADER FEELING ADJUST: hardware control
VU and non-addressed LEDs: no wire identity in this list
M14 AUX LEVEL: front panel, retained in MIDI; not in top crop
Mirrored right-side controls share vendor figs; representative top targets only
MODE and pad banks retain all valid MIDI rows; HTML joins one representative per fig
Eight PAD7/8 variants have invalid printed statuses; see midi.json unavailable

controls.label: BROWSE
controls.notes: [B1] Relative rotation: clockwise 1-30, counterclockwise 127-98, up to 30 clicks/40 ms. PDF p2.
